description: This file defines classes related to handling MIME attachments in SOAP communications, specifically for MIME-aware SOAP clients and servers using the NuSOAP toolkit with PEAR Mail_MIME libraries.

classes.name: nusoapclientmime
classes.description: A SOAP client supporting MIME attachments, allowing addition of attachments to outgoing SOAP messages and parsing response attachments.

classes.name: nusoapservermime
classes.description: A SOAP server supporting MIME attachments for handling incoming requests with attachments and generating responses with attachments.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds a MIME attachment to the current request or response, either using data directly or reading from a file.

methods.name: clearAttachments
methods.description: Clears the current list of MIME attachments for request or response.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves the list of MIME attachments associated with the current request or response.

methods.name: getHTTPBody
methods.description: Constructs the HTTP body for requests/responses, including MIME parts if attachments are present.

methods.name: getHTTPContentType
methods.description: Returns the HTTP content type header for the current request/response, including MIME boundary if needed.

methods.name: getHTTPContentTypeCharset
methods.description: Returns the charset for the HTTP content type or false if not applicable.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses SOAP response messages, extracting attachments if present.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses incoming SOAP requests, extracting attachments if present.
